topic: Universal action representation and robot-specific adapters

paper.title: SPACE: Enabling Learning from Cross-Robot Data Toward Generalist Policies

claim: A recorded robot action is not a universal supervision signal: the same command can produce different motions across controllers, embodiments, hardware units, and deployment-time dynamics.

evidence.summary: SPACE predicts Cartesian state deltas as a shared end-effector-space representation and uses an action adapter to convert them into robot-specific control commands, improving cross-robot and dynamics-shift robustness.
evidence.locator: Abstract; Section 1 Introduction; Section 3.2 Inconsistency of Control Commands across Robots; Section 4 SPACE

notes: This paper helps separate 'action as command token' from 'action as physical state change'.

paper.title: 3PoinTr: 3D Point Tracks for Learning Manipulation from Unconstrained Human Videos

claim: 点轨迹数据的瓶颈不是只在采集量，而在可见性、遮挡、深度和 embodiment 分割；真实操作中暂时被遮挡的关键物体点仍应保留监督信号。

evidence.summary: 论文用可见性mask保留部分遮挡轨迹并逐点逐时刻mask损失，认为这比丢弃含不可见点的轨迹能提供更多任务关键监督；附录说明真实视频需2D跟踪、深度提升到3D、SAM3分割人手并移除embodiment点。
evidence.locator: 4.3 Results: 3D Point Track Prediction; Appendix D Data Collection Details; Appendix G Future Work

notes: 作者也指出当前仍依赖较一致的实验室视频，透明、遮挡、反光和阴影会影响2D跟踪。

paper.title: $τ_0$-WM: A Unified Video-Action World Model for Robotic Manipulation

claim: 异构4D数据必须保留监督可靠性层级：机器人数据给可执行动作，人类/第一视角视频给视觉动态，UMI式数据给较弱的动作式信号，缺失模态不能强行当真值。

evidence.summary: 论文把真实robot data、UMI-style data和egocentric videos划分为不同监督等级，并用modality-specific supervision masks让每条样本只参与其实际拥有的视觉、状态、动作和进度损失。
evidence.locator: I Introduction; III Data Sources for Predictive Robot Learning; Unified supervision; IV-C Joint Flow-Matching Objective

notes: 这与本地EA-DATA的“数据层级/质量治理”一致。

paper.title: TacForeSight: Force-Guided Tactile World Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation

claim: 如果目标包含扰动恢复，数据集必须显式收集nominal demonstrations和recovery interaction data；否则模型很难学习接触丢失后的再建立。

evidence.summary: TacForeSight在perturbation-aware设置中额外收集恢复示教，让外部扰动发生在执行中并要求示教者重新建立稳定接触；完整模型在三个扰动任务上报告90%、85%、85%平均完成/成功分数。
evidence.locator: IV-B 2 Perturbation-Aware Evaluation; IV-C Main Results; Table I

notes: 这说明失败/恢复数据不是评测附属品，而是训练分布的一部分。 Full-text extraction provenance revalidated on 2026-07-14.

paper.title: HapTile: A Haptic-Informed Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Dataset for Contact-Rich Imitation Learning

claim: 多模态4D示教数据必须做同步、时间戳、动作-状态一致性、触觉标记跟踪和episode级切分；否则模型会混淆动作真值、接触信号和评测泄漏。

evidence.summary: HapTile说明所有模态通过机器人控制循环同步，检查空/损坏轨迹和timestamp gaps，验证action-state consistency；附录还要求episode-level split避免temporal leakage，并保留raw/rectified tactile images。
evidence.locator: 3.2 Synchronization and Data Quality Control; A.1 Data Formatting; A.2 Tactile Sensor Data Processing

notes: 这是数据治理证据，直接对应本项目EA-DATA。 Full-text extraction provenance revalidated on 2026-07-14.

paper.title: SIEVE: Structure-Aware Data Selection for Imitation Learning with VLA Models

claim: VLA 示教数据质量的关键不只是数量，而是减少冗余、噪声和覆盖不均，并保留可复用的行为结构；结构感知筛选能让更少数据优于全量训练。

evidence.summary: 论文指出大规模机器人示教池常含轨迹冗余、噪声示教、次优行为和任务覆盖不均；SIEVE 按可复用 primitive 与 transition 选择中心、稳定、适合模仿的轨迹，在多数据集和 VLA 模型上可用 50% 示教与 50% 训练步数超过全量训练。
evidence.locator: Abstract; Introduction; SIEVE; Conclusion

notes: Fresh arXiv HTML extracted on 2026-07-08; candidate promoted from current six-month search. Full-text extraction provenance revalidated on 2026-07-14.

topic: 具身智能数据质量的主要矛盾

paper.title: Lift3D-VLA: Lifting VLA Models to 3D Geometry and Dynamics-Aware Manipulation

claim: 物理操作中的高质量数据需要显式承载 3D 几何和时间动态；只依赖 2D 视觉预训练会在几何约束、遮挡、接触和动态一致性上丢信息。

evidence.summary: 论文将 2D VLA 的困难归因于几何理解和空间推理不足、3D 数据和强 3D encoder 稀缺、跨模态 lifting/projection 损失几何 fidelity；其 GC-MAE 用伪点云监督当前点云重建和未来几何演化，并在仿真与真实任务中提升成功率。
evidence.locator: Abstract; I Introduction; IV-C Geometry-Centric Masked Autoencoding; V-B Multi-Task on MetaWorld and RLBench

notes: Uses pseudo 3D annotations from a visual-geometry model; treat as geometry-supervision evidence rather than proof of raw 3D ground-truth sufficiency. Full-text extraction provenance revalidated on 2026-07-14.

paper.title: Quality over Quantity: Demonstration Curation via Influence Functions for Data-Centric Robot Learning

claim: 示教数据质量不应只用相似度、互信息或人工启发式代理指标定义；QoQ 将高质量轨迹定义为对目标验证示范 loss 降低和策略性能提升有直接贡献的数据。

evidence.summary: 论文指出人类遥操作会带来错误、操作约束、技能差异、噪声和次优行为；QoQ 用 influence functions 衡量训练 state-action 对验证示范的贡献，并在轨迹层聚合以降低噪声、保持覆盖，在仿真、真实机器人和 DROID in-the-wild 数据上改善策略成功率。
evidence.locator: I INTRODUCTION; II-B Robot data curation; VI CONCLUSIONS

notes: arXiv HTML extracted to work/literature-review-embodied-data-quality-last-year-20260708/html-extracts/2603.09056.json Full-text extraction provenance revalidated on 2026-07-14.

paper.title: Closing the Loop in Teleoperation: Episode-Level Data Quality Assessment and Feedback for High-Quality Demonstration Collection

claim: 遥操作 episode 不能只按成功/失败验收；数据质量需要结合语义任务进度、运动平滑性、停顿、关节极限等遥测信号，并把反馈闭环给采集员。

evidence.summary: DQAF 框架从 sub-task progress、motion smoothness、stalls、kinematic limits 抽取质量信号，生成结构化质量评估和自然语言纠正建议；pilot study 中即时反馈条件呈现更高任务完成度、更高 episode-level quality scores 和更少 detected suboptimalities 的趋势。
evidence.locator: I INTRODUCTION; Abstract; V-D Pilot Study Design; VI-B Pilot Study Results

notes: Pilot study sample is small; treat the user-study result as exploratory rather than definitive. Full-text extraction provenance revalidated on 2026-07-14.

paper.title: An Efficient Metric for Data Quality Measurement in Imitation Learning

claim: 面向部署环境的 end-user 示教，低质量常表现为过度纠正、振荡和突兀调整；轨迹功率谱密度 PSD 可作为无需 rollout、专家标签或重新训练的快速质量排序指标。

evidence.summary: 论文把 poor-quality end-user demonstrations 具体化为 excessive corrective motions、oscillations 和 abrupt adjustments，并提出基于 demonstration trajectories PSD 的自动排序指标；实验比较未筛选、oracle、现有排序和 jerk/path-length 等 baseline，研究 PSD 筛选对下游 IL 成功率和平滑性的影响。
evidence.locator: Abstract; I INTRODUCTION; V Experiments

notes: Metric is positioned for scalable in-field curation; applicability to contact-rich industrial tasks still needs task-specific validation. Full-text extraction provenance revalidated on 2026-07-14.

paper.title: WARP-RM: A Warp-Augmented Relative Progress Reward Model for Data Curation

claim: 混合质量的长程示教不应粗粒度整条丢弃；次优 episode 里可能含有高价值恢复片段，质量控制需要下探到 frame/chunk 级别的进展信号。

evidence.summary: 论文指出长程遥操作包含 pauses、fumbles 和 recoveries，整条 episode 过滤会丢失 otherwise suboptimal executions 中嵌入的 high-advantage segments，也无法剪掉保留示教中的局部 hesitation；WARP-RM 学习 dense relative progress 并用 WARP-BC upweight high-advantage action chunks。
evidence.locator: 1 Introduction; Abstract; 2 Related Work

notes: Use as evidence against binary keep/drop episode-level quality control.

paper.title: Imitating What Works: Simulation-Filtered Modular Policy Learning from Human Videos

claim: 人类视频能扩大机器人学习数据来源，但其质量取决于机器人可执行性和任务兼容性；仿真过滤可把不可达、估计错误或 grasp 不兼容的轨迹排除或标注出来。

evidence.summary: PSI 将人类演示转换为 6DoF object pose trajectories 后在仿真中执行，用于过滤不适合机器人学习的数据；不适合原因包括 pose estimation errors 和机器人 physically unachievable trajectories，并生成 grasp suitability labels 以学习 task-oriented grasping。
evidence.locator: 1 Introduction; 3.3 Trajectory and Grasp Filtering via Simulation; Abstract

notes: Use as evidence that L0 human-video data needs feasibility filters before becoming robot-policy data.

paper.title: SoftVTBench: A Safety-Aware Visuo-Tactile Benchmark for Physically Constrained Robotic Manipulation of Deformable Objects

claim: 只看任务完成会低估传感器感知误差的真实风险；柔性物操作需要把安全交互、滑移/掉落和过度形变作为独立评测目标。

evidence.summary: 作者指出现有 manipulation benchmarks 多以 success 为中心，很少评估执行过程是否物理安全；SoftVTBench 分开报告 Goal Success 和 Safety Success，后者要求无掉落并限制峰值形变。实验显示 success-only evaluation 会显著高估策略表现，而触觉感知可改善 Safety Success 并降低物体形变。
evidence.locator: arXiv HTML Abstract; 1 Introduction; 3.1 Benchmark Design; 4.2 Main Results
evidence.short_quote: success-only evaluation substantially overstates policy performance

notes: Benchmark is simulation-based with FEM hidden states; real-world transfer remains a separate question. Full-text extraction provenance revalidated on 2026-07-14.

paper.title: Validate the Dream Before You Trust Its Verdict: Admissibility for World-Model Simulators

claim: 世界模型/生成式仿真器不能仅凭视觉逼真度作为具身策略评测裁判；必须验证其是否按动作正确响应，并建立 admissibility/validation 梯度后才能把闭环判决当证据。

evidence.summary: 作者指出机器人中 World Models 越来越被用于模拟动作后果并给出 success/safety verdict，但视频生成指标如 FVD 奖励视觉真实感，却忽略世界是否对 policy actions 正确响应；他们主张作为 test oracle 的 WM 需要先通过 accreditation，并提出 L0-L4 admissibility ladder。
evidence.locator: arXiv HTML Abstract; I Introduction; III-A The Credibility Gap
evidence.short_quote: visual fidelity does not predict the action-robustness

notes: The paper instantiates part of the argument in autonomous driving; the review uses it as an evaluation-governance signal for embodied world models generally. Full-text extraction provenance revalidated on 2026-07-14.

paper.title: GigaWorld-1: A Roadmap to Build World Models for Robot Policy Evaluation

claim: 数据质量必须经闭环评估定义；对机器人世界模型来说，短期视觉真实感不如长程、动作忠实的 rollout 一致性更能决定其作为策略评估器的可靠性。

evidence.summary: 论文指出真实机器人策略评估受硬件和人工监督限制，是基础模型迭代瓶颈；WMBench 用真实 teleoperation 数据和匹配 policy rollouts 构造评估，并分析 7 个视频世界模型、4 种动作表示和 324,000 余次模拟 rollout。其结论强调 evaluator 质量由长程 action-faithful rollout consistency、可迁移物理先验、动作编码、记忆和评估导向 post-training 共同决定。
evidence.locator: Abstract; 1 Introduction; 4.2 Evaluation Protocol; 5.2 How Do Pretraining and Training Data Matter?; 7 Discussion and Conclusion

notes: Supports the evaluation side of data quality: policy-relevant causal fidelity over visual-only metrics. Full-text extraction provenance revalidated on 2026-07-14.

paper.title: Revisiting Embodied Chain-of-Thought for Generalizable Robot Manipulation

claim: 感知增强不自动带来更好的动作生成;高层语义推理只有转译成动作相关表示才有用,把 CoT 当动作前缀会引入 compounding errors,且 dense grounding 字段本身会受检测误差、标定偏差和遮挡污染。

paper.title: World Model for Robot Learning: A Comprehensive Survey

paper.title: Perturbation-Based Uncertainty for Failure Detection in Vision-Language-Action Models

claim: VLA 的感知-动作误差不只来自传感器本身，也来自分布外观测下模型无法给出可靠置信度；隐藏激活扰动产生的 epistemic signal 可用于失败检测。

evidence.summary: 作者指出现代 VLA 常用回归或 flow-based action generation，缺少显式预测概率；他们通过对 transformer hidden activations 注入高斯扰动，利用扰动后动作预测分歧估计不确定性，并在 LIBERO/LIBERO-PRO 的分布偏移下提升失败检测。
evidence.locator: arXiv HTML Abstract; I Introduction; IV-D Main Results

notes: Benchmark evidence is simulation/benchmark based, not field deployment. Full-text extraction provenance revalidated on 2026-07-14.

paper.title: Uncertainty Quantification for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models

claim: Flow-based VLA 在真实部署时缺少置信度机制会形成安全与恢复缺口；velocity-field disagreement 可把动作预测的不可靠性转成失败检测和主动微调信号。

evidence.summary: 作者将真实非平稳环境中的分布外场景描述为 VLA 可能“无预警失败”的关键限制，并提出用小 ensemble 的 velocity-field disagreement 量化 epistemic uncertainty；LIBERO 实验显示该不确定性与下游表现、失败检测和主动采样相关。
evidence.locator: arXiv HTML Abstract; 1 Introduction; Appendix B.4 Uncertainty Quantification

notes: The paper focuses on flow-based VLA; claims should not be generalized to every robot policy architecture without qualification. Full-text extraction provenance revalidated on 2026-07-14.

paper.title: PATCH: Action-Chunk-Conditioned Latent Patch Innovation Monitoring for Robot Manipulation

claim: 全局视觉异常、帧级变化或策略不确定性不足以判断感知误差是否会影响当前动作；部署监控需要把异常限定到 action chunk 将要使用的执行走廊。

evidence.summary: 作者指出开放工作空间中移动物体、瞬时遮挡和目标运动附近扰动会让部署脆弱；现有 runtime monitors 往往依赖全局 observation anomalies、policy uncertainty 或 frame-level visual changes，难以区分任务相关执行风险和无害视觉变化。PATCH 通过 active action chunk 的 projected execution corridor 累计持续残差作为介入信号。
evidence.locator: arXiv HTML Abstract; 1 Introduction ¶ S1.p1-S1.p3; 3.2 PATCH Monitor
evidence.short_quote: task-relevant execution risk from benign visual variation

notes: Useful as a failure-monitoring perspective; it is not a sensor-hardware paper. Full-text extraction provenance revalidated on 2026-07-14.

paper.title: You Only Touch Once: 6-DoF Object Pose Estimation from Single Tactile Contact

claim: 物体 6-DoF 位姿误差在遮挡、弱光、反光/透明表面下会让视觉方法失效；单次双触点触觉可作为视觉不可靠时的位姿观测补充。

evidence.summary: 作者明确指出视觉位姿估计常在遮挡、差光照、反光或透明表面下失败，并提出 tactile-only pose estimation：把触觉接触表示成局部 3D 点云，结合校准传感器位姿恢复完整 6-DoF object pose；实验在视觉不可靠时优于视觉和几何基线。
evidence.locator: arXiv HTML Abstract; 1 Introduction; 4.2 6-DoF Object Pose Estimation under Occlusion
evidence.short_quote: vision-based methods often fail under occlusion

notes: The result is object-pose-specific; it supports tactile complementarity, not tactile replacement for all perception tasks. Full-text extraction provenance revalidated on 2026-07-14.

paper.title: Tactile-WAM: Touch-Aware World Action Model with Tactile Asymmetric Attention

claim: 触觉不是简单加 token 就能提升；接触任务中的 RGB 未来可能视觉上合理但物理上不完整，而无约束触觉注入还可能污染视频和动作预测。

evidence.summary: 作者指出 insertion、assembly、search、reorientation 依赖 slip、jamming、contact normals 和小对齐误差，这些状态在 RGB 中弱可见或不可见；同时他们定义 tactile pollution：无约束触觉 token 注入会迫使视觉 dynamics model 吸收稀疏局部事件式接触信号，从而退化视频和动作预测。
evidence.locator: arXiv HTML Abstract; I Introduction; Appendix B Method Details; Appendix D Limitations and Future Work
evidence.short_quote: visually plausible futures can be physically incomplete

notes: This is a high-signal caveat for multimodal fusion: more sensors can add failure modes if fusion geometry/timing is wrong. Full-text extraction provenance revalidated on 2026-07-14.

paper.title: TACO: TActile World Model as a Self-COrrector forScalable VLA Post-Training

claim: 接触丰富任务中的小接触扰动会造成视觉难以发现的不可恢复失败；触觉世界模型可把真实失败转成可训练的局部纠正片段。

evidence.summary: 作者指出 VLA 在 contact-rich tasks 中会被小接触扰动触发不可恢复失败，且这些失败常难以单靠视觉检测；TACO 用 tactile-aware world model 识别 failure-adjacent states、想象局部 correction segments 并标注可执行纠正动作，真实接触任务报告相对 base policy 的成功率提升。
evidence.locator: arXiv HTML Abstract; 1 Introduction; 3.1 Tactile-Aware World Model; 4.2 Main Results
evidence.short_quote: hard to detect from vision alone

notes: Performance numbers are author-reported; the key extracted claim is the error mechanism and corrective use of tactile world models. Full-text extraction provenance revalidated on 2026-07-14.

paper.title: Multisensory Continual Learning: Adapting Pretrained Visuomotor Policies to Force

claim: 力觉/触觉/音频能揭示图像不可直接观测的交互状态；但这些模态硬件和任务依赖强，所以需要在少量多传感数据上适配既有视觉策略，而不是预训练时穷尽所有传感器。

evidence.summary: 作者称接触丰富任务常依赖 vision 之外的 sensory data，force、tactile 或 audio feedback 能揭示 images 中不可直接观察的 interaction states；但这些模态 hardware- and task-specific，且大规模多传感数据稀缺。他们提出 MuSe，将 limited multisensory data 融入 pretrained vision-only policies，并以 force-torque sensing 做真实任务案例。
evidence.locator: arXiv HTML Abstract; 1 Introduction; 4.1 Cross-Modal Generalization
evidence.short_quote: interaction states not directly visible from images

notes: The claim is conditional on sensor availability and task relevance; it should not be read as always adding every modality. Full-text extraction provenance revalidated on 2026-07-14.

paper.title: Event-VLA: Action-Conditioned Event Fusion for Robust Vision-Language-Action Model

claim: RGB-centric VLA 在照明变化导致的可见性退化下会暴露鲁棒性问题；事件流作为对照明更鲁棒、对运动敏感的补充观测，可以改善不同可见性水平下的动作预测。

evidence.summary: 作者指出现有 VLA 往往假设稳定明亮的室内环境，而真实操作中 illumination shifts 会造成 degraded RGB observations；Event-VLA 将 degraded visibility 定义为 RGB-centric policies 的鲁棒性问题，并通过 action-query routing 将 event streams 融入 action representation，仿真和真实部署实验显示在不同可见性下保持更强鲁棒性。
evidence.locator: arXiv HTML Abstract; 1 Introduction; B.2 Event Encoder and Feature Distillation
evidence.short_quote: degraded RGB observations caused by illumination shifts

notes: This evidence targets visual sensor degradation rather than contact-state errors. Full-text extraction provenance revalidated on 2026-07-14.

topic: 具身智能数据质量的主要矛盾

paper.title: TACO: TActile World Model as a Self-COrrector forScalable VLA Post-Training

claim: 接触丰富任务里的失败常是视觉不可见的局部接触扰动；仅用视觉世界模型会产生看似合理但接触不一致的轨迹，因此纠错数据需要触觉/力反馈参与。

evidence.summary: 论文指出 VLA 在接触丰富任务中会因轻微接触扰动产生不可恢复失败，这些失败难以从视觉单独检测；TACO 用 tactile-aware world model 将真实 rollout 中的失败邻近状态转成想象的视触觉纠正片段和可执行纠正动作，在真实接触任务中相对 base policy 提升 44 个百分点成功率。
evidence.locator: Abstract; 1 Introduction; 2 Related Work; 3 Method; 5 Conclusion and Limitations

notes: Supports a limit claim against vision-only data and world-model rollouts in contact-rich settings. Full-text extraction provenance revalidated on 2026-07-14.
